newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN up ahead of full-yr earnings.
newsitem.headline: EVN up ahead of full-yr earnings.

text.p: Shares in Lower Austrian regional utility Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich (EVN) were the top gainer in Vienna on Friday, rising 1.81 percent ahead of full-year earnings on November 12.
At 1011 GMT, EVN shares were 27 schillings up at 516 on turnover of 19,082 lots.
"People are expecting very good results because of the cold winter and a less than spectacularly warm summer," said a market participant.

EVN's financial year ends on August 31. Nine-month earnings rose 27.9 percent and the company has said it expects a significant improvement for the full-year on 1994/5's 1.193 billion schillings pre-tax profit. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
